preferredWrite.decision: One record per contact: { contactId, assignTags: { privateTags: { tagIds } } }, contactId in the body as well as the path so the readiness grant checks both references. Assign-only (never unassign), so a retry or unknown outcome resends safely. Read back GET /contacts/v5/contacts/{id}?fields=TAGS and check every tag id is present. The crosswalk row maps the source assignment key to the contact id.

pitfalls.summary: VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-27 : update-tags stores a tag id that does not exist (e.g. 'zzzzz'). Tag ids come only from read-back crm/label records via the readiness grant.
VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-27: when body contactId differs from the path, Wix writes the path contact. The builder builds both from the same contactId.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-27: tags sent inside the default (OVERWRITE) contact upsert replace a matched contact's existing tags; OVERWRITE without tags keeps them. Labels go on contacts through this entity only.
A member's contact is a crm/contact produced as the member write's secondary output; the per-record crm/contact reference resolves it the same way.

mappingGuidance: Dependencies: crm/contact (contactId) and crm/label (each tag id) are per-record; a contact with no source labels has no record here and never waits.

Emit one record per contact that has labels: contactId = resolveReference('crm/contact', contactKey, 'contactId'), each tag id = resolveReference('crm/label', labelKey, 'assignTags.privateTags.tagIds[i]'). Send with assignContactLabels(recordClient, { contactId, tagIds }).

evidence.note: Update Contact Tags: assign/unassign private tags on one contact

Verified live 2026-10-27 (probe P1/P3/P4, throwaway site): update-tags with label.tagId -> tag on contact, repeat harmless; bulk upsert OVERWRITE replaces tags; body/path contactId mismatch writes the path contact; missing contact 404; unknown tag id accepted (trap); probe records deleted

notes: Added 2026-10-27 so source labels land on contacts. Kept apart from crm/contact so contacts without labels never wait for labels and the contact writers stay unchanged.
